title: The Bermuda Triangle
text: The Bermuda Triangle is an area of the Atlantic Ocean between Miami, Puerto Rico and the island of Bermuda. Many people believe that ships and planes disappear there mysteriously.

The most famous story happened in 1945. Five military planes, called Flight 19, were flying over the area. Suddenly the pilots said that their compasses were not working correctly. The planes never came back, and nobody found them.
After that, people quickly invented many explanations. Some said that aliens took the planes. Others talked about the lost city of Atlantis under the sea, or about strange magnetic forces.

But scientists think differently. The area is one of the busiest in the world, so it is normal that some accidents happen there. Also, the weather changes very rapidly: there are sudden storms and powerful currents that can carry objects far away.

In fact, insurance companies say that the Bermuda Triangle is not more dangerous than other parts of the ocean. Ships cross it safely every day. The real mystery is why the legend is still so popular.
q: What explanation did some people give?
Why do scientists think accidents happen there?
It is a busy area with sudden storms
It is not more dangerous than other areas
It is the most dangerous place

grammar.title: Grammar: adverbs of manner
grammar.rule: Adverbs of manner say how something happens. Most are made with adjective + -ly.
items: ___ the pilots said that something was wrong.
Ships cross the area ___ every day.

es.title: El Triángulo de las Bermudas
es.sub: Barcos y aviones que desaparecieron... ¿o no?
es.grammar: Gramática: los adverbios de modo dicen cómo pasa algo. La mayoría se forma con adjetivo + -ly (como -mente).
